heroHeading: Flexible, Secure Containerised Storage in Birmingham
heroSubheading: Secure containerised storage in Birmingham, with collection from your home and redelivery whenever you're ready. Ideal for gaps between completion dates, renovations and student summers, in a dry, CCTV-monitored facility with an itemised inventory of everything stored.
summary: When completion dates fail to align or you need temporary space during property renovations, our secure Birmingham storage solutions protect your furniture and boxed belongings. Our movers collect items directly from your home, catalog everything on a clear inventory sheet, and transport your goods in our clean removal van to modern, 24/7 CCTV-monitored storage facilities. Retrieve individual items whenever needed or schedule complete delivery directly to your new address.
benefits: 24/7 CCTV surveillance, perimeter alarms, and climate-controlled units
Complete collection and redelivery service by our removals team
Comprehensive itemised inventory created upon container loading
Flexible rolling weekly or monthly rental terms with no lengthy lock-ins
Direct van-to-container loading to minimise handling

process.title: Storage Volume Sizing
process.description: We determine the appropriate container volume (from 35 sq ft rooms to full 250 sq ft units) required to house your belongings safely.

process.title: Collection & Inventory
process.description: Our team loads your items from your property into protective transit blankets, itemising every carton and piece of furniture.

process.title: Secure Warehouse Storage
process.description: Your goods are stored in our secure, dry, purpose-built Birmingham storage facility under round-the-clock monitoring.

process.title: Scheduled Redelivery
process.description: When your new property is ready, simply give us notice and we deliver, unload, and reassemble items in your new home.

whatsIncluded: Clean, dry, purpose-built wooden or steel storage containers
24/7 CCTV and access control security monitoring
Protective furniture pads and sofa covers while stored
Digital barcode tracking and written storage manifest
Optional collection and redelivery by our removal crew
whatsNotIncluded: Storage of food, plants, or perishable organic materials
Storage of flammable fluids, gas canisters, or paints
Storage of firearms, explosives, or illegal contraband
Self-access outside standard warehouse operational hours without notice
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a 35 sq ft personal container (equivalent to a studio flat or decluttering load).

faqs.question: How does containerised storage work compared to self-storage?
faqs.answer: With our containerised storage, we load your goods directly into secure storage containers at your home or warehouse, sealing them on site. This cuts handling in half compared to self-storage, saving you time and preventing damage.

faqs.question: How much notice do I need to give to access or retrieve my goods?
faqs.answer: We ask for at least 48 hours notice so our warehouse technicians can safely locate and unstack your storage container for your access or scheduled delivery.

faqs.question: Is insurance included while my items are stored?
faqs.answer: Basic cover is included and comprehensive storage insurance can be scaled according to your declared inventory value.

faqs.question: Can I store just a few bulky furniture items during decorating?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly store single suites, dining sets, or carpet clearance items for periods ranging from two weeks to several months.
